sentences.text: Shri Govind Pal Singh Songara - Advocate for the appellan  Shri H.S.Rathore - Govt. Advocate for the respondent / St Heard on I.A.No.6318/2025, fourth application under Section 430 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C.) for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of the appellant Jeevan @ Kundan S/o Bherulal.

The appellant stands convicted under Sections 363, 366 and 376(3) of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 5(L)/6 and 5(J)(ii)/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo 03 years' RI with fine of Rs.1,000/-; 05 years' RI with fine of Rs.1,000/-; 20 years' RI with fine of Rs.1,000/-; 20 years' RI with fine of Rs.1,000/-; and 20 years' RI with fine of Rs.1,000/- respectively with usual default stipulation.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
Appellant's earlier application was dismissed on merit.
The victim became pregnant at the age of 15 years and 06 months and abortion was carried out with the permission of Court.
In this case, life of a minor girl has been spoiled by the applicant by committing the crime.
Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, we are of 2 CRA-7306-2022 the view that no case for grant of suspension of sentence is made out.

(VIVEK RUSIA) (GAJENDRA SINGH)
